requirements.statement: Valid food preparations containing serving-container terms must remain accepted while object-only descriptions continue to be rejected, including open positive and negative classes.
230g ameixa roxa must resolve deterministically through the local text path to a real plum reference, preserving quantity and avoiding external semantic/provider dependence.
Specific and semantically meaningful qualifiers such as ameixa em calda must retain precedence over the generic raw-plum alias.
Nutrition fallback decisions must use canonical logInferenceEvent with low-cardinality reasons, no user free text, and best-effort failure handling without duplicating provider telemetry.
The implementation must use develop as its base branch.
